statement: The proportion of cases with issues related to prenatal care coordination differs between NCFRP_v51 and PRAMS_P7_ARF.
rationale: This study compares how specific prenatal care issues are recorded in NCFRP_v51 (case series) versus broader health check-ups tracked by PRAMS_P7_ARF (population reference).
prior_art: None in the inputs. The closest claims highlight data quality and ascertainment issues but do not address differences in recording methods between datasets.
cannot_establish: This design cannot establish causality or incidence rates, as it only compares recording methods among cases and does not include a denominator source.
